profile.name: 科学数据显示通道
profile.description: 这不是独立物理仪器，而是用于实验室科学数据可视化的软件显示通道组件。它管理图像、谱线或多维数据的显示方式，包括色图、亮度、对比度、切片区间、序列/集合索引和显示范围，常用于显微、成像或测量数据的浏览与分析。
profile.description_en: This is not a standalone physical instrument but a software display-channel component for laboratory scientific data visualization. It controls how images, spectra, or multidimensional datasets are shown, including color maps, brightness, contrast, slice intervals, sequence/collection indexing, and display limits, for viewing and analysis of microscopy, imaging, or measurement data.

registry.name: Display Data Channel
registry.description: Display Data Channel是一款后处理设备，主要功能包括关闭、复位、执行、数据保存、校准、状态查询。支持Signal, Slot, about to be inserted等操作。
